body.name: Pointwise-cell and conditional-Gram projector
body.construction: Set \(W=\operatorname{diag}(w)\), \(D=\operatorname{diag}(Bw)\), and \(R=D^{-1}BW\). Define the first elimination by \(N=N_B=I_{K^{2}}-D^{-1}B(B^{\mathsf T}D^{-1}B)^{+}B^{\mathsf T}=I_{K^{2}}-R(R^{\mathsf T}DR)^{+}R^{\mathsf T}D\), residualize the \(2K^{2}\) measurement vectors as \(h=N_Bc\), set \(G(X)=E_P(hh^{\mathsf T}\mid X)\) and \(b_{f_0}(X)=E_P\{h(N_Bf_0)\mid X\}\), and define \(Qf_0=N_Bf_0-h^{\mathsf T}G(X)^{+}b_{f_0}(X)\)
